idea: Replace the daily standup meeting with an async, five-minute-max written update each person posts every morning in one channel, plus a short auto-generated digest that surfaces only genuine blockers so nobody has to read every update to find them.
customer: A software team spread across enough time zones, or interruption-sensitive enough, that a synchronous daily standup doesn't fit everyone -- and the lead who currently reads every update themselves to catch real blockers.
pieces: not decomposed -- moved here from problems/ during cleanup: its old pieces were hand-authored by Claude before the 'never predefine the pieces' rule was established. See BRIDGE.md and README.md.
